name: Qwen 2.1 Photo 2K SAM3 + Native + Torso Lock
readme: Requires successful unified GitHub image build. 2 Photo/SAM3 workflows + 34 Native identity workflows + 4 Torso Lock workflows. Photo model downloader manages one BF16 Qwen weight set. No model weights in Docker layers. Use A40 48GB or more, preferably generous system RAM. Unset the start command and entrypoint overrides. Do not select int8-only: Native/Torso need BF16.
